renderer: Microsoft Word for Mac 16.114.1, macOS 27.0.1, Apple Silicon
method: Each file opened alone with `open -a "Microsoft Word"` from a scratch folder, Word idle before each (no document or dialog open); prompts read and answered through System Events. No recovery chosen, no preference changed, nothing saved. The control was opened before the first variant and after the last. A first pass that opened the files without waiting for Word to be idle mixed up the prompts and was discarded.
operator: Claude Code driving Word through AppleScript, with the maintainer's permission; not blind to the expectations.
unrelated: On launch an installed Adobe PDF add-in raised Visual Basic run-time error 53; dismissed with End.
